regions.today: Widespread mist and fog, dense in parts, will gradually lift this morning, lingering in some places into the afternoon. It will be a largely dry day, with just the odd coastal shower, and some bright or sunny spells developing. Another cool day with highs of just 7 to 11 degrees, in light variable breezes.
regions.tonight: Mainly dry tonight, with areas of mist and fog returning, turning dense again in some parts, mainly in central and northern parts of the region. Lowest temperatures of 1 to 7 degrees with light easterly or variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Monday, will be a little milder and breezier than previous days. Mist and fog will once again lift to leave a dry day for most, with bright or sunny spells developing. Cloud will increase from the southwest later. Highest temperatures of 8 to 13 degrees, with light to moderate easterly breezes.
